prompt: Create a high-fidelity UI design comp: one portrait 393x852 phone viewport, no phone hardware, for Herdr Mobile, a minimal terminal client. Three muted status subgroup labels 'Needs input', 'Finished', 'Working', two rows each. The list fills only its natural height; remaining area is empty flat dark surface. At the absolute bottom a single 48px full-width text button 'Spaces' with an upward chevron, opening a navigation sheet. This is OPTION A: priority plus Spaces sheet. Use the enclosed reference ONLY for the software window's material: restrained charcoal #1b2024, lighter charcoal row hover #2d3236, off-white text, yellow/red/teal tiny activity dots, subtle gray hairline boundaries. Use readable 16px system UI names, no large titles, no marketing, no logo tile, no cards, no gradients, no rounded pill tabs, no ornamental icons, no metrics. All touch rows have generous invisible target area yet feel compact. Crisp production-ready Android webapp, perfect text alignment. The subject is the actual minimalist app list, not a marketing graphic. Absolutely do not repeat the reference's social-preview title/paragraph/platform badges. Comp only the phone page.
